impl LaneDrainForTheStrip {
    fn drain_controls_for_lane(&mut self, control: &mut Consumer<Record>, kind: Kind) {
        match kind {
            Kind::FaderGainChangeForTheLaneWithAVeryLongName
            | Kind::FaderTrimChangeForTheLaneWithAVeryLongName => {
                let available = control.available_at_entry();
                for _ in 0..available {
                    let Ok(record) = control.try_pop() else {
                        break;
                    };
                    self.apply(record);
                }
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
}
